benchmarks.name: RoboCasa365 official leaderboard — Overall (50-task multi-task)
benchmarks.description: RoboCasa365 official leaderboard (robocasa.ai/leaderboard.html, RoboCasa 1.0.1): Overall = average task success over the 50-task multi-task benchmark (18 Atomic-Seen + 16 Composite-Seen + 16 Composite-Unseen), policies trained on Human300 pretraining data, verified submissions. New _2611 id because the board re-evaluated entries (GR00T N1.5 with 1.5x longer horizon; RoboCasa 1.0.1 update) and its values differ from the paper-reported values on robocasa365/robocasa365_* (e.g. RLDX-1 36.0 vs paper 32.1); existing robocasa365 id also mixes GR-1 tabletop semantics.
